name: Alto
source:
A cheerful and friendly boy aspiring to become a full-fledged bard.

Traveling across the country, he crosses paths with the heroine and her companions in a variety of places, bringing energy and warmth wherever he goes.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
